marta: Quick flag from Saturn partner call  some customers see small billing gaps after we switched to hourly entitlements. They feed minute-aggregates and we convert -> hours. Need a short playbook for reconciliation.

yoel: Likely causes: timezone normalization, minute->hour rounding, and missing dedupe keys on retries.

claire: Repro in staging: partner minute bucket at 00:00:00+01:00 sometimes mapped to previous hour when we assumed UTC. Also observed minute buckets retransmitted on flaky networks producing duplicate minute rows.

marta: Immediate mitigations: require minute_start to include offset (ISO8601) or a tz field; accept either seq_id OR content_hash; add ingest-side dedupe window TTL=72h keyed by sha256(partner+device+minute_epoch).

yoel: Tiny schema suggestion (text-only here): usage_key, sku, qty_hours (string), window_start (ISO), seq_id optional, content_hash optional, signature header X-Partner-Sig. Qty as "0.01666667" for one minute.

claire: Reconciliation policy proposal: daily diff job 00:30 UTC comparing partner-declared effective hours vs our billed hours. Thresholds: auto-adjust if delta <= 0.5% or delta_hours <= 2h; create billing-review card if 0.5%<delta<=2% or delta_hours in (2,20]; escalate if delta>2% or delta_hours>20h. Finance/legal to confirm.

finance-bot: Noted thresholds for review; legal flagged regulated tenant exceptions (no-auto-adjust).

marta: Backfill notes: Saturn will provide last 14d minute archives S3 path. We'll dry-run transform into canonical usage_batch, surface per-account diffs, pilot adjustments for 5 accounts, then apply wider adjustments. All backfills must be dry-run first.

yoel: Action items: yoel implement ingest dedupe + tz normalize (ETA 48h); claire build reconcile job + dashboard panel (ETA 72h); marta coordinate partner call + finance/legal loop + draft customer note (ETA 24h). I'll add metrics duplicate_count and delta_pct.

saturn-bot: Uploaded sample -> s3://saturn-partners/archives/minute-agg/2026-08-*.json

marta: I'll host partner sync tomorrow 9am PT. Please bring sample payloads and the dry-run checklist. We'll convert actions to Jira after the call. Thanks everyone.
